control_semantics: Historical controls restore the specified Git-pinned reconciler body while retaining r4 shared modules, templates and tests; these are localized rollbacks, not pristine historical-tree runs. Other faults alter the named rule in memory on r4. The Unicode rollback restores only the old format-control predicate. The identifier-supplement control removes only the r4 additions table. Every candidate and control count was freshly observed in this r4 audit.
